# `config/` — Scenario definitions

**What is in here.** `scenarios/` holds the generator config, the twelve canonical scenario JSONs (six layouts x two modes) and their SHA-256 list. The v1 configs sit alongside, unchanged.

**How it is produced.** Generated by `python -m dns.generator --all`; byte-identical for the same config and seed.
